column2: Ghal Bol — manzo mai ɓoye saƙo
Rubutu 1:1 da kiraye-kirayen murya/bidiyo — ba tare da lambar waya ba; makullai da rubuce-rubuce a na'urarka.
Ghal Bol: nan take, na sirri, saƙonni da kiraye-kiraye kai tsaye tsakanin na'urori

Kayan da ke fitowa ƙarƙashin alamar Ghal Bol — rubutu mai ɓoye kai tsaye tsakanin na'urori, rasitocin isarwa da karatu, da kiraye-kirayen murya/bidiyo na asali tsakanin abokan hulɗa da ke kan layi. Sunan manhajar jama'a shine Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol).
Ana rufe saƙonni a na'urarka. Akwatin isarwa yana riƙe da rubutun ɓoye mara haske kawai har sai mai karɓa ya yarda.
Kiraye-kiraye suna haɗuwa kai tsaye a LAN idan ya yiwu, in ba haka ba ta hanyar gada mai sauƙi ta daidaitawa wadda ba ta buɗe midiya ba.
Shaidar da na'ura ke da ita
Kowane shigarwa yana ƙirƙirar shaidar ɓoye ta gida. Gayyata da QR ko mahaɗi — ba tare da lambar waya ko shiga ta hanyar zamantakewa ba.
Duba sau ɗaya. Haɗa idan kana kan layi.
Baƙo yana duba QR na mai masauki (ko ya buɗe mahaɗin gayyata). Baƙo yana ajiye maɓallin jama'a na mai masauki kuma ya buga. QR na bangarori biyu ba a buƙata ba.
Raba mahaɗinka https://ghalbol.com/connect/… ko QR daga Gayyata a cikin Ghal Bol.
Suna buɗe shi a cikin Ghal Bol (ko su shigar da farko daga Play ko Linux).
Idan duka biyu ana iya isa gare su, tattaunawa da kiraye-kiraye suna haɗuwa — ga kiraye-kiraye, hanyoyin LAN da WAN suna tafiya tare.
Fakitocin Windows ana gina su daga wurin aiki ɗaya. Zazzagewar jama'a a wannan shafi ita ce damfarin tebur na Linux; Android yana fitowa a Google Play a matsayin com.ghalbol.
Shigar da Ghal Bol daga Play. App Links da aka tabbatar suna buɗe gayyatoci kai tsaye cikin manhaja idan ya yiwu.
Buɗe ajiyar fitowa, sai ./install.sh (ga kowane mai amfani) ko ./run.sh don gwada a wurin.

Gotigin alamar kasuwanci ce (Inda fasaha ta haɗu da gano). GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED kamfani ne. Ghal Bol alamar kayayyakin sadarwa ce; wannan shafi ghalbol.com ne. Manzo shi ne abin da ke fitowa yau. Sunayen fakiti da yanki suna kasancewa ghalbol — kalma ɗaya. Babu alama daban ta camel case.
Damfarin samarwa na x86_64. Buɗe ajiya, sai ka gudanar da ./install.sh (ga kowane mai amfani, zuwa ~/.local) ko ./run.sh don gwada a wurin.
An buɗe a cikin wata manhaja (misali WhatsApp)
Wannan burauzar ciki ba za ta iya buɗe Ghal Bol ba. Taɓa menu ka buɗe wannan shafi a Chrome, ko ka kwafi mahaɗin manhaja ka manne shi a Ghal Bol → Shiga.
Taɓa Buɗe a Ghal Bol a ƙasa. Idan babu abin da ya faru, kwafi mahaɗin manhaja ka manne shi a Ghal Bol (Shiga).
Shiga don Ghal Bol. Duk zaɓuɓɓuka — imel, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, ko waya.
Ci gaba da imel, mai samar da sabis, ko waya.
Yi amfani da kalmar sirri mai haruffa 6 aƙalla.
Kalmar sirri ba daidai ba ce.
Imel ko kalmar sirri ba daidai ba ne.
Ba a ba wannan yanki izini don Firebase Auth ba.
Ba a kunna wannan hanyar shiga ba tukuna.
Ƙoƙari ya yi yawa. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
Yi amfani da cikakkiyar lambar waya tare da lambar ƙasa (misali +91…).
Lambar SMS ɗin ba daidai ba ce ko ta ƙare.
Ba a tabbatar da imel ba tukuna — duba akwatin saƙonku
An aika imel na tabbatarwa — duba akwatin saƙonku
Ba a sami shafi ba — Ghal Bol
Babu komai a wannan adireshin. Mahaɗin gayyata yana kama da haka: ghalbol.com/connect/… — duba an kwafa shi gaba ɗaya.
